description: Two detuned square waves through a lowpass and a highpass, shaped by one decay, in the manner of the 808 cowbell

params.text: Sets the pitch of both squares together: the upper one 1000Hz to 1600Hz and the lower one 520Hz beneath it; the tooltip and the manual quote half those figures
Sets how fast the pair fades, 20ms fully anticlockwise to 120ms fully clockwise
Fires the sound; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires the sound; the length of the gate makes no difference

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
a trigger restarts the phase of the upper square only, so the two oscillators meet differently on every hit and no two hits sound quite alike

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
